scope: actual finite-window raw-word CDC component with external compiler-reservation fixture; not integrated endpoint/FEC or physical clock contract

positives.base: 4096 exact words, repeated raw word2 preserved

mutants.drop: actual RTL skipped storage write at word13 -> mismatch
mutants.absent: write observed-valid missing at compiled slot -> fault
mutants.early: read schedule too early -> ownership fault

scheduling: all writes/reads follow explicit fixed reservations; Gray ownership checks are fault-only; no payload classification/drop/insert/ready
